$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A network frame
description: One line of a link's NDJSON: signed by the host that sent it and, between hosts, sealed for the host it's for. The gateway sees the head and never the body.

seq.description: Set by the gateway, per recipient, within its epoch: what a host resumes after

from.description: The host that sent it, whose key signed it

anyOf.description: The host's id in the network, picked by the person: never the machine's own name

to.description: The host it's for, or * for every host (presence and claims, sealed once per host)

at.description: When the sender made it, by its clock

sealed.description: Whether body is sealed to the recipient's X25519 key; frames between hosts always are

body.description: The sealed bytes, or the JSON of an unsealed gateway frame

sig.description: Ed25519 over the head: xenonet-net/1, network id, id, kind, from, to, at, sealed (1 or 0) and the base64url SHA-256 of the body bytes, joined by newlines
